verdicts.reason: A is the better resize. It keeps the headline on one line and keeps a sensible top-to-bottom rhythm, but it has flaws. The headline nearly touches the side margins. The button has lost its pill shape and now has squarer corners. The peach circle sits behind the subcopy and the left side of the CTA, so the lower third looks crowded while the bottom is left empty. B has worse problems. Its headline wraps and leaves 'fizz' alone on the second line. The peach circle has moved to the top-left, where it competes with the SOLSTICE logo. The subcopy and the button are jammed together, and about 80px of dead space is left at the bottom.
